{{Top|leg}}
'''Gomman''' was an employee of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lestra Oxic]]. He worked for the attorney, providing security and covert services as one of his agents, and was viewed as one of his best men. In [[43 ABY]], he was assigned to protect the star witness in [[Colla-Arphocc Automata]]'s lawsuit against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].
